Auth.checkEmailBody: We've sent you a link to confirm your email. If it doesn't arrive in a few minutes, check your spam folder, or log in to get a new one.
Auth.emailConfirmedBody: You're signed in and ready to go.
Auth.linkExpiredBody: Confirmation links work once and only for a limited time. Log in and we'll send you a new one.
Auth.forgotPasswordBody: Enter the email you signed up with and we'll send you a link to choose a new password.
Auth.resetSentBody: If an account exists for that email, we've sent a link to reset your password.
Auth.passwordUpdatedBody: For your security, you've been signed out on all devices. Log in with your new password.
Auth.resetLinkInvalidBody: Reset links work once and only for a limited time. Ask for a new one below.

Hi,

Hi,

Use this link to choose a new password:
{url}

If you didn't ask for this, you can ignore this email.
